title: Whitespace runs and the paragraph mark never size a line that holds ink; a no-break space does
source: spacerun-word.pdf (Times New Roman 12 one-line paragraphs, 6 per variant between Arial markers; Word for Mac direct PDF, pymupdf baselines): Times control 13.68/13.92, every space / tab variant the same, Calibri 14 mark the same, Calibri 14 no-break space 17.04/17.28, sz 2 space-only paragraphs 1.20

cases.note: mid-line ' ' run inheriting Calibri 11: 13.78, the inherited face does not win max()
Calibri 14 paragraph mark over Times 12 text: 13.78
tab-only Calibri 14 run between the Times runs: 13.82
the Calibri 14 space run gives up its line box
U+00A0 is ink: the Calibri 14 no-break space lifts the line to 17.09 = 14 x 1.2207
a space-only paragraph has no ink to yield to: the mark (sz 2) sizes it, 1.20
lastRenderedPageBreak before the ' ' run: still mark-sized, 1.20
